arguments.question: For ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA over 21/63 sessions, assess dated geopolitical and trade-policy channels that could materially affect semiconductor supply chains, cross-border AI/networking demand, cloud-capex customers or digital advertising. Separate verified policy developments from scenarios; identify issuer/ETF transmission differences and stop after one or two material primary-policy sources or record unavailable evidence.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether shared policy/geopolitical dependencies materially alter otherwise issuer-specific theses and whether a cross-watchlist review condition is warranted.
